frequency_question: How often do announced major tariffs take effect without being delayed, rescinded, or replaced by a negotiated agreement within the implementation window?
membership_rule: Includes: formally announced executive tariff actions on major economic partners intended for implementation within a short window. Excludes: standard WTO dispute outcomes, broad multi-year legislative tariff phase-ins.

cases.name: 2019 US Threat of Tariffs on Mexico over immigration
2019 US Threat of Tariffs on EU over Airbus
2025 US Threat of Tariffs on BRICS currency

coverage_note: 7 named major recent cases; believed to represent the primary instances of this class in modern US trade policy.
known_gaps: Older historical precedents from pre-WTO eras are excluded to maintain relevance to modern executive trade authorities.
validity_reason: Executive trade enforcement mechanisms and negotiation dynamics remain stable across typical presidential administrations over this timeframe.
